items.statement: Complete objects and defensible structural/electronic states
items.expected: Verify complete PAl12/BC18F15 composition, charge/electron count, spin parity and a bijective atom map to actual geometry files. Evaluate structural retention or change from the submitted evidence. Candidate, constrained stationary point, valid minimum and claimed lowest state are distinct. Require credible stationarity/state validity and search coverage when those claims are made; no prescribed spin list, binding sites or intact winner is required. An observed reconstruction can invalidate an intact-object claim or support a limited scientific exclusion, but one failed calculation cannot establish global nonexistence. Read actual submitted files and tool provenance, resolve identifiers and recompute the quantities supporting the claim. No old scalar target or universal uncalibrated tolerance applies. Missing evidence cannot be scored as an indistinguishable result. Judge alternative valid routes by the same scientific standard, not by agreement with the author or completion of a private reference matrix. Award full criterion credit only when its substantive claim is supported over its stated domain; partial credit requires independently valid evidence and explicit missing coverage. Award no credit to the affected claim when essential identity, validity or evidence is absent; fluent explanation does not repair it. These are judgment anchors, not a calibrated numerical equivalence threshold.

Claiming shell preservation or a specific charge-transfer mechanism requires corresponding electronic evidence; geometry or correlation alone is insufficient. Evidence-backed non-author explanations, null effects or scoped non-identifiability receive equal scientific consideration.
